Home.heroLead: Tell us what you learn, when you are free and how you like to learn — in person, by phone or over video. We match you with a chavrusa who fits, and you take it from there.
Home.heroReassurance: A free account takes a minute and shows you everyone learning nearby.
Home.step1Title: Choose what you want to learn
Home.step1Body: Choose the subjects you want to learn, along with your level and other learning preferences.
Home.step2Body: Choose the days and times that realistically work for you — mornings, evenings, between Mincha and Maariv, Shabbos afternoon, or whatever fits your schedule.
Home.step3Body: We'll show you learners who match by subject, level, availability, and learning preferences. Browse the results and find someone who feels like a good fit.
Home.step4Body: Connect and communicate through the site. Once you both agree, exchange contact details and begin learning together.
Home.ctaBody: Set up a profile in about ten minutes and see who near you is looking for the same seder.

Profile.title: My Profile
Profile.languagesSpoken: Language you'd like to talk in
Profile.completeYourProfile: Complete your profile so others can find you.
Profile.noProfileYet: You haven't set up your profile yet.
Profile.contactSectionHint: Only shared with a learner once you've confirmed a session together — never shown while browsing.
Profile.displayNameHint: Public — everyone browsing sees this. Many people use a first name and last initial, like “Zalman B.”, but it's up to you.
Profile.fullNameHint: Private. Only shown to someone once the two of you are matched, the same way your contact details are.
Profile.displayNamePromptBody: Your display name was shortened automatically from the name you'd entered, so it may not read the way you'd like. Edit it below and save — your full name is kept separately and stays private.
Profile.studyLanguagesHint: The language you want to learn the text in — which may not be the language you'd rather talk in.
Profile.blurbPlaceholder: e.g. Looking to learn a daf a week with someone patient — I'm coming back to Gemara after a long break.
Profile.blurbHint: Shown on your profile, and searched when someone types keywords into Browse.
Profile.ageRangeVisibilityHint: Shown as a range, never an exact age. Turn it off and it's hidden from your profile and from age filters.

Location.requiredHint: Required — you're only learning in person, so people need to know where to find you.
Location.optionalHint: Optional. Add it if you'd like people near you to find you more easily.
Location.meetingSpotPlaceholder: e.g. the shul on Ocean Parkway
Location.meetingSpotHint: A shul, library or landmark where you'd like to learn. Shown to anyone who views your profile.
Location.requiredError: Please choose your country and city — they're required when you only learn in person.

Map.intro: Areas are shown as circles sized by how many learners are there. Nobody is placed individually — an area needs at least {min} learners before it appears.
Map.noClusters: No area has enough learners to show on the map yet. Try the list view, or widen your filters.
Map.offMap: {count, plural, =1 {# learner isn't shown on the map} other {# learners aren't shown on the map}} — either they haven't set a location, or their area is below the minimum.
Map.namesHidden: Names are hidden in map view. You'll see them in the list, and after you connect.
Map.fallbackTiles: Map tiles are running on a fallback provider.
Map.mapFailedBody: The list view has the same learners, with the same filters applied.

Browse.noResults: No learners match your filters yet. Try adjusting them.
Browse.notVisibleTitle: You're not visible to others yet
Browse.notVisibleBody: You can browse freely, but your profile stays hidden until you verify your phone number. Verifying keeps the community safe.
Browse.nearNeedsCity: Searching by distance needs a city on your own profile, picked from the list.
Browse.filterKeywordPlaceholder: Search what people are looking for
Browse.nearExcluded: {count, plural, =1 {# learner was left out of this distance search} other {# learners were left out of this distance search}} because their city isn't one we can place on the map.

Browse.emptyFilteredBody: {count, plural, =0 {Clearing your filters would show everyone here.} =1 {Clearing your filters would show # learner.} other {Clearing your filters would show # learners.}}

Safety.blockConfirmQuestion: Block {name}? They won't be able to see your profile or contact you, and you won't see them either.

Admin.adminUserNotice: This user is an admin — suspend and delete are disabled for admin accounts.
Admin.deleteConfirmQuestion: Delete this profile permanently? Their matches, requests, blocks and reports go with it.
Admin.deleteHint: Deleting removes profile data but not the login itself — the person could sign up again. To keep someone out, suspend the account instead.
Admin.dashboardAllClear: Nothing needs your attention right now.
Admin.photosIntro: Photos stay invisible to everyone until approved here — including to people already matched with the uploader.
Admin.photoNotePlaceholder: Optional note to the person (shown if rejected)
Admin.photoActionFailed: That didn't go through. Please try again.
Admin.photosQueryFailed: Couldn't load the photo queue. The error is in the server logs — this is not the same as the queue being empty.
Admin.matchesIntro: Ending a match here does the same thing as either person ending it themselves.
Admin.matchesQueryFailed: Couldn't load matches. The error is in the server logs — this is not the same as there being none.
Admin.unmatchLogIntro: Kept so that repeated matching and unmatching — which would otherwise reveal a name and photo each time, leaving no trace — is visible.

Phone.title: Verify phone

Match.unmatchAdminConfirm: End this match on both users' behalf?
Match.unmatchConsequences: Any scheduled sessions are removed, and each of you goes back to seeing only what you saw before matching — no full name, no photo. Either of you can send a new request later.
Match.unmatchFailed: Couldn't end the match. Please try again.

Account.emailHint: Only you can see this. Changing it means changing the account it signs in with, so it isn't edited here.

Notice.menOnly: Chavrusa Link is currently for men only. If you're a woman looking for a study partner, please <link>reach out via our contact form</link> for more information.

Messages.title: Messages
Messages.hint: Only the two of you can read this. Phone and contact details stay hidden until you confirm a session together.

Emails.newMessageFootnote: You are receiving this because you are matched with this learner. Ending the match ends these emails.
